title: Germantown B-Side Retreat | 3BR/3Ba Near Broadway
description:
Welcome to The Germantown B-Side Retreat, a stylish 3BR/3BA Nashville home about a mile from Broadway. Enjoy the best of both worlds: quick access to downtown, Germantown restaurants, and Music City fun, then come home to a quieter neighborhood setting. With three full baths, cozy bedrooms, inviting living spaces, and a well-equipped kitchen, it’s ideal for families, friends, and longer stays. A friendly walkable neighborhood with nearby restaurants, coffee shops, grocery store and yoga studio.

The space
5 beds total: includes 2 King beds, 2 Queen beds & Queen sofa sleeper.

1st (main) floor includes: 
-1 bedroom with a King bed and full bathroom adjacent. 
-Living Room with Queen Sofa Sleeper
-Kitchen/Dining Room
-Main entrance and access to back patio/deck/parking

Upstairs on 2nd floor includes: 
-Bedroom with a King bed and attached bathroom;
-Bedroom with 2 Queen beds and attached full bathroom 
-Laundry room with washer/dryer
